title: Release Train Pulse: Cross-surface blackout windows, capacity guardianship, and on-call readiness
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: define an operational playbook that harmonizes blackout windows, dynamic capacity gates, and on-call readiness signals for cross-surface release trains (runtime / console / API). Scope: create adaptive blackout windows (regional + global), capacity guardianship rules (soft and hard throttles), a lightweight signal mesh for roll/cutover decisions, and a runbook for SRE/PM/ENG on-call. Objectives: 1) Reduce unexpected rollbacks by 30% during first 72 hours post-rollout. 2) Keep median P95 latency regressions below 10% for gated releases. 3) Ensure 15-minute responder handoff and clear ownership matrix for every train. Acceptance criteria: documented blackout calendar, automated capacity checks integrated with capacity-metric dashboard, failover lanes mapped and tested in staging, a runbook with 4 clear escalation tiers, and one dry-run rehearsal with production-like traffic. Rollout plan: 1) Draft guardrail definitions and thresholds with infra and runtime teams (week 1). 2) Implement telemetry hooks and gating signals in console and runtime (week 2). 3) Schedule rehearsal with canary cohort and verify telemetry thresholds (week 3). 4) Ramp policies to pilot teams and iterate (week 4). Key signals: sustained queue growth > 15% for 3 minutes, cluster CPU/GPU saturation > 80% for 2 minutes, error-rate spike > 2x baseline for 5 minutes, and canary quality regression > 5% on defined test prompts. Owners: PM (Aisha Patel) coordinates cross-team scheduling; Runtime eng (Carlos Mendez) owns capacity checks; Console eng (Sofia Nguyen) owns calendar UI; SRE (Priya Rao) owns on-call escalation. Communication: pre-launch announcement to all stakeholders, daily morning pulse during week-of-launch, and a single Slack channel per train with pinned runbook. Contingencies: immediate throttling to cohort 0, failover to previous model variant, and regional traffic shifting. Documentation: link artifacts below. Notes: avoid hard freezes longer than 48 hours; prefer staggered blackout lanes by region and time-of-day to accommodate APAC customers. This ticket focuses on orchestration and ops playbook rather than code-level kernel optimizations.
